requirements.requirement: The system shall complete parts searches in under 15 seconds to avoid disrupting user workflow.
requirements.source_citation: under a quarter of a minute? Maybe around fifteen seconds feels okay to me.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states that parts searches should feel instant and provides a specific target time of under 15 seconds. This indicates a clear performance requirement.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific actions or system states should be considered complete for the purposes of measuring search performance?

requirements.requirement: The system shall complete facility lookups in under 8 seconds to ensure smooth user experience during customer interactions.
requirements.source_citation: under ten seconds — like eight seconds would be nice.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder specifies that facility lookups should be snappier than parts searches and provides a target time of under 8 seconds.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific actions or system states should be considered complete for the purposes of measuring facility lookup performance?

requirements.requirement: The system shall generate audit reports in under 10 seconds to allow users to complete tasks without switching contexts.
requirements.source_citation: under maybe ten seconds? Quick enough that I don't have to switch tasks.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states that audit report generation should be quick and provides a target time of under 10 seconds.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific actions or system states should be considered complete for the purposes of measuring audit report generation performance?

requirements.requirement: The system shall confirm save actions within 5 seconds to provide users with confidence that their actions have been successfully saved.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder specifies that save actions should feel immediate and provides a target time of under 5 seconds.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific actions or system states should be considered complete for the purposes of measuring save confirmation performance?

requirements.requirement: The system shall maintain performance with up to 1,500 concurrent users during peak times to ensure smooth operation for all users.
requirements.source_citation: about fifteen hundred people at the same time in the worst-case scenario.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentions that the system slows down with a large number of users and provides an estimate of 1,500 concurrent users during peak times.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific performance metrics should be maintained under peak load conditions?

requirements.requirement: The system shall provide help functionality in approximately 90% of screens to assist users in completing tasks without external assistance.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states that help should be available in most places and provides a target of 90% of screens.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific types of help functionality (e.g., tooltips, inline guidance, videos) should be provided in each screen?

requirements.requirement: The system shall require no more than two days of hands-on, onsite training for 95% of users to become comfortable with the system.
requirements.source_citation: two days of hands-on, onsite training... for ~95% of users to be comfortable.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder specifies the expected duration and effectiveness of training for most users.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics or tasks will be used to assess user comfort and proficiency after training?

requirements.requirement: The system shall provide warnings before session timeouts and save drafts to prevent loss of unsaved work.
requirements.source_citation: warnings before session timeouts... save drafts so I don't lose work.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for warnings before session timeouts and the saving of drafts to prevent work loss.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific actions or system states should trigger warnings before session timeouts?

requirements.requirement: The system shall achieve 98% uptime to minimize disruptions during business hours.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder specifies the target uptime percentage to ensure system availability.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific measures will be taken to monitor and ensure the system meets the 98% uptime requirement?

requirements.requirement: The system shall handle spotty networks gracefully in the field, allowing users to view cached results and continue working.
requirements.source_citation: must handle spotty networks gracefully — maybe cache things or allow me to at least view the last results.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentions the need for the system to handle spotty networks in the field and suggests caching as a solution.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific caching strategies and fallback mechanisms should be implemented to ensure operability under spotty network conditions?

requirements.requirement: The system shall separate data by insurer to prevent unauthorized access to other companies' claims and provide tiered access based on user roles.
requirements.source_citation: we sometimes work with multiple insurers... I don't want to accidentally open another company's claim... tiered access — admins wide, most folks narrow.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for data separation and tiered access based on user roles.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific mechanisms will be used to enforce data separation and tiered access?

requirements.requirement: The system shall provide a clean and uncluttered UI to reduce user errors and improve user satisfaction.
requirements.source_citation: make the UI uncluttered... clean, I'll be happier and make fewer mistakes.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly states the need for a clean and uncluttered UI to improve user satisfaction and reduce errors.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific design principles and guidelines will be followed to ensure a clean and uncluttered UI?

requirements.requirement: The system shall provide a short skills check or quick survey to assess the effectiveness of training and ensure that 95% of users are comfortable with the system.
requirements.source_citation: short skills check or quick survey... to assess training effectiveness.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder specifies the need for a short skills check or quick survey to assess training effectiveness and ensure that 95% of users are comfortable with the system.
requirements.follow_up_question: What specific metrics or tasks will be included in the skills check or survey to assess training effectiveness?
